statement:
theorem circleDeficit_coe_eq_mul_finiteDeficit_circleAverage
    {g : ℂ → ℝ} (c : ℂ) {R C : ℝ}
    (hg : Continuous g)
    (hC : ∀ z ∈ sphere c |R|, g z ≤ C) :
    circleDeficit (fun z => (g z : EReal)) c 1 R C =
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) *
        ((C : EReal) - ((Real.circleAverage g c R : ℝ) : EReal)).toENNReal

    (hw : w ≤ ((Real.circleAverage g c R : ℝ) : EReal)) :
    circleDeficit (fun z => (g z : EReal)) c 1 R C ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ((C : EReal) - w).toENNReal

theorem circleSubmean_of_continuous_antitone_majorants
    {w : ℂ → EReal} (c : ℂ) {R C : ℝ} (g : ℕ → ℂ → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ n, Continuous (g n))
    (hC : ∀ n, ∀ z ∈ sphere c |R|, g n z ≤ C)
    (hanti : ∀ t : ℝ, Antitone fun n =>
      (g n (c + circleMap 0 R t) : EReal))
    (hinf : ∀ t : ℝ, (⨅ n, (g n (c + circleMap 0 R t) : EReal)) =
      w (c + circleMap 0 R t))
    (hcenter : ∀ n, w c ≤ ((Real.circleAverage (g n) c R : ℝ) : EReal)) :
    circleDeficit w c 1 R C ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Real.pi) * ((C : EReal) - w c).toENNReal

    {R r s : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hr : R / 2 ≤ r) (hs : R / 2 ≤ s) :
    (r - s) ^ 2 + (R ^ 2 / 4) * ‖e - f‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖r • e - s • f‖ ^ 2

name: PshLines.PSHD.annulus_complex_smul_lower_bound

    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {z w : ℂ}
    (hz : R / 2 ≤ ‖z‖) (hw : R / 2 ≤ ‖w‖) :
    (‖z‖ - ‖w‖) ^ 2 + (R ^ 2 / 4) * (2 - 2 * ‖inner ℂ e f‖) ≤
      ‖z • e - w • f‖ ^ 2

name: PshLines.PSHD.annulus_inner_norm_lower_bound

name: PshLines.PSHD.normalized_affineLift_max_lower_bound
statement:

statement:

    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℂ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    {e : E} (he : ‖e‖ = 1) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hd : s < Module.finrank ℝ (ℝ × (ℂ ∙ e)ᗮ))
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ C : ℝ≥0∞, C < ⊤ ∧ ∀ (u : E → ℝ), Measurable u →
      ∀ (D : Set E) (x : E), closedBall x R ⊆ D →
      (∀ v : E, v ≠ 0 → DiscPshOn (fun z => (u (x + z • v) : EReal))
        ((fun z : ℂ => x + z • v) ⁻¹' D)) →
      ∃ μ : Measure E, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
        μ {y | ‖y - x‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u x ≤ u y} = 1 ∧
        rieszEnergy s μ ≤ C

        ((fun z : ℂ => x + z • v) ⁻¹' D)) →
      ∃ μ : Measure E, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
        μ {y | ‖y - x‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u x ≤ u y} = 1 ∧
        rieszEnergy (2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) μ ≤ C

      ∫⁻ U, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (g U x) ^ 2 ∂volume ∂unitaryHaar E =
        projectionConstant e₀ * rieszEnergy ((2 * (Module.finrank ℂ E - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) μ

    (x : ComplexModel n) :

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem four_mul_coordinateLeviTrace_explicitRadialPoissonPotential_of_ne_zero

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.leviForm_comp_norm_sq
statement:
theorem leviForm_comp_norm_sq {G : ℝ → ℝ} (hG : ContDiff ℝ 2 G)
    (x v : H) :
    leviForm (fun y : H => G (‖y‖ ^ 2)) x v =
      deriv G (‖x‖ ^ 2) * ‖v‖ ^ 2 +
        deriv (deriv G) (‖x‖ ^ 2) * ‖inner ℂ x v‖ ^ 2

name: PshLines.Regularization.RadialLeviPreimage.realHessian_comp_norm_sq

theorem realHessian_comp_norm_sq {G : ℝ → ℝ} (hG : ContDiff ℝ 2 G)
    (x v w : H) :
    realHessian (fun y : H => G (‖y‖ ^ 2)) x v w =
      4 * deriv (deriv G) (‖x‖ ^ 2) * inner ℝ x v * inner ℝ x w +
        2 * deriv G (‖x‖ ^ 2) * inner ℝ v w

statement:

    coordinateRadialKernel ν R hR j x =

name: PshLines.Regularization.AdaptedRadialLeviPreimage.exists_adaptedRadialScaleDifferenceLeviPreimage
statement:
theorem exists_adaptedRadialScaleDifferenceLeviPreimage
    (hn : 0 < Module.finrank ℂ E)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ ψ : E → ℝ,
      (∃ G : ℝ → ℝ, ∀ x : E,
        ψ x = G (‖adaptedComplexModelEquiv x‖ ^ 2)) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ ∧
      (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) ∧
      HasCompactSupport ψ ∧
      tsupport ψ ⊆ adaptedComplexModelEquiv ⁻¹'
        closedBall 0 (R / ((a : ℝ) + 1)) ∧
      ∀ x,
        4 * ∑ j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ E),
          leviForm ψ x (adaptedCoordinateVector (E := E) j) =
            adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR a x -
              adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR b x

theorem four_mul_sum_leviForm_adaptedRadialPoissonPotential_eq_kernel_sub

    4 * ∑ j : Fin (Module.finrank ℂ E),
      leviForm (adaptedRadialPoissonPotential μ R hR a b) x

        adaptedRadialKernel μ R hR b x

    ∃ R > 0, ∃ U : Opens E, ∃ K : Compacts E,
      x ∈ U ∧ U ≤ Ω ∧ (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω ∧

name: PshLines.Regularization.distributionPairing_hasFDerivAt_of_supSeminorm_remainder
statement:
theorem distributionPairing_hasFDerivAt_of_supSeminorm_remainder
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) (z : E)
    (hrem : ∀ m : ℕ,
      (fun h : E =>
        ((Finset.Iic m).sup
          (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K))
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK (z + h) -
            cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z -
            cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM χ κ hκ K hχK z h))
        =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E => h)) :
    HasFDerivAt
      (fun w => distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ
        (cutoffTranslatedKernelSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK w))
      ⟨(distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ).toLinearMap.comp
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM χ κ hκ K hχK z),
        ((distributionOnSupportedInCLM T K hKΩ).toLinearMap.comp
          (cutoffTranslatedKernelFirstJetLM χ κ hκ K hχK z)).continuous_of_finiteDimensional⟩
      z

    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [AddCommGroup A] [Module ℝ A]
    (p : Seminorm ℝ A) (L : A →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hL : ∀ a : A, |L a| ≤ C * p a)
    (Φ : E → A) (Ψ : E →ₗ[ℝ] A) (z : E)
    (hrem : (fun h : E => p (Φ (z + h) - Φ z - Ψ h)) =o[𝓝 0]
      (fun h : E => h)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun w => L (Φ w))
      ⟨L.comp Ψ, (L.comp Ψ).continuous_of_finiteDimensional⟩ z

name: PshLines.Regularization.exists_uniform_iteratedFDeriv_translation_remainder_bound
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_iteratedFDeriv_translation_remainder_bound
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    (κ : E → ℝ) (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ)
    (K : Compacts E) (z : E) (m : ℕ) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ y ∈ (K : Set E), ∀ h : E, ‖h‖ < δ →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m κ (y - (z + h)) -
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ m κ (y - z) -
          fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ m κ) (y - z) (-h)‖ ≤
        ε * ‖h‖

statement:
theorem cutoffTranslationFirstRemainder_seminorm_isLittleO
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (z : E) (r : ℕ)
    (A : ℕ → ℝ) (B : ℕ → E → ℝ)
    (hA0 : ∀ i ≤ r, 0 ≤ A i)
    (hA : ∀ i ≤ r, ∀ y ∈ (K : Set E),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (χ : E → ℝ) y‖ ≤ A i)
    (hB0 : ∀ j ≤ r, ∀ h, 0 ≤ B j h)
    (hB : ∀ j ≤ r, ∀ h, ∀ y ∈ (K : Set E),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (translationFirstRemainder κ z h) y‖ ≤ B j h)
    (hBo : ∀ j ≤ r, (B j) =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E ↦ h)) :
    (fun h : E ↦
      ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K r
        (cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z h))
      =o[𝓝 0] (fun h : E ↦ h)

statement:

    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (z h : E) (r : ℕ)
    (A B : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hA0 : ∀ i ≤ r, 0 ≤ A i) (hB0 : ∀ j ≤ r, 0 ≤ B j)
    (hA : ∀ i ≤ r, ∀ y ∈ (K : Set E),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (χ : E → ℝ) y‖ ≤ A i)
    (hB : ∀ j ≤ r, ∀ y ∈ (K : Set E),
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (translationFirstRemainder κ z h) y‖ ≤ B j) :
    ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K r
        (cutoffTranslationFirstRemainderSupportedIn χ κ hκ K hχK z h) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (r + 1),
        (r.choose i : ℝ) * A i * B (r - i)

name: PshLines.Regularization.leviForm_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing
statement:
theorem leviForm_distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedSpace ℂ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {Ω : Opens E} (T : 𝓓'(Ω, ℝ)) (χ : 𝓓(Ω, ℝ)) (κ : E → ℝ)
    (hκ : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) κ) (K : Compacts E)
    (hχK : tsupport χ ⊆ K) (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) (z v : E) :
    leviForm
        (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ κ hκ K hχK hKΩ) z v =
      (distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ
          (realHessianDirectionalKernel κ v)
          (realHessianDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ v)
          K hχK hKΩ z +
        distributionCutoffTranslatedPairing T χ
          (realHessianDirectionalKernel κ (Complex.I • v))
          (realHessianDirectionalKernel_contDiff κ hκ (Complex.I • v))
          K hχK hKΩ z) / 4

statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_convolution_right
    (L : E →L[𝕜] E' →L[𝕜] F) {f : G → E} {g : G → E'}
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hcg : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hg : ContDiff 𝕜 (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) (n : ℕ) (x : G) :
    iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n (f ⋆[L, μ] g) x =
      (f ⋆[convolutionRightIteratedCLM (G := G) L n, μ]
        iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n g) x

name: PshLines.Regularization.iteratedFDeriv_convolution_right_apply
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_convolution_right_apply
    (L : E →L[𝕜] E' →L[𝕜] F) {f : G → E} {g : G → E'}
    (hf : LocallyIntegrable f μ) (hcg : HasCompactSupport g)
    (hg : ContDiff 𝕜 (⊤ : ℕ∞) g) (n : ℕ) (x : G)
    (m : Fin n → G) :
    iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n (f ⋆[L, μ] g) x m =
      ∫ t, L (f t) (iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 n g (x - t) m) ∂μ

    (hKΩ : (K : Set E) ⊆ Ω) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (G : FiniteJetSpace E m →L[ℝ] ℝ),
      ∀ f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K,

    (K : Compacts E) (m : ℕ)
    (L : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hL : ∀ f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K,
      |L f| ≤ C *
        ((Finset.Iic m).sup
          (ContDiffMapSupportedIn.seminorm ℝ E ℝ ⊤ K)) f) :
    ∃ G : FiniteJetSpace E m →L[ℝ] ℝ,
      ∀ f : ContDiffMapSupportedIn E ℝ ⊤ K,
        G (finiteJetCLM K m f) = L f

    {u : E → ℝ} (hum : Measurable u) {D : Set E} (x : E)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hball : closedBall x R ⊆ D)
    (hu : ∀ v : E, v ≠ 0 → DiscPshOn (fun z => (u (x + z • v) : EReal))
      ((fun z : ℂ => x + z • v) ⁻¹' D))
    (m : Measure (Icc (R / 2) R × sphere (0 : E) 1)) [IsProbabilityMeasure m] :
    ∃ Ψ : (Icc (R / 2) R × sphere (0 : E) 1) → E, Measurable Ψ ∧
      (∀ s, u x ≤ u (Ψ s) ∧ ∃ z : ℂ,
        ‖z‖ = (s.1 : ℝ) ∧ Ψ s = x + z • (s.2 : E)) ∧
      m.map Ψ {y | ‖y - x‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u x ≤ u y} = 1

      ((fun z : ℂ => x + z • v) ⁻¹' D))
    (k : ℕ) (m : Measure (Icc (R / 2) R × sphere (0 : E) 1))
    [IsProbabilityMeasure m] :
    ∃ μ : Measure E, IsProbabilityMeasure μ ∧
      μ {y | ‖y - x‖ ∈ Icc (R / 2) R ∧ u x ≤ u y} = 1 ∧
      rieszEnergy (2 * k : ℕ) μ ≤
        ∫⁻ p, (ENNReal.ofReal
          (((p.1.1 : ℝ) - (p.2.1 : ℝ)) ^ 2 + (R ^ 2 / 4) *
            (2 - 2 * ‖inner ℂ (p.1.2 : E) (p.2.2 : E)‖)) ^ k)⁻¹ ∂m.prod m
